summary: Phase 2 testing complete for ProDelivery Bacău platform. All Phase 2 features verified: 1) Backend refactored to modular routers, 2) Driver scheduling system with weekly calendar, 3) Order cancellation with mandatory reason, 4) Analytics without financial data. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly.

api_root_v2.details: GET /api/ returns 'Delivery Platform API v2.0' message

auth_all_roles.details: All 3 logins work: admin@delivery.ro, driver-001@delivery.ro, rest-001@delivery.ro

stats_no_revenue.details: GET /api/stats returns stats WITHOUT total_revenue field

analytics_endpoint.details: GET /api/stats/analytics returns orders_by_driver, orders_by_restaurant, cancelled_orders, cancelled_count

schedule_create.details: POST /api/schedules creates/updates driver schedule with slots and total_hours

schedule_admin_summary.details: GET /api/schedules/admin/summary returns all 5 drivers with schedule summaries

cancel_without_reason_400.details: PUT /api/orders/{id}/status with CANCELLED returns 400 when no cancellation_reason

cancel_with_reason_success.details: PUT /api/orders/{id}/status with CANCELLED + cancellation_reason succeeds, stores reason and cancelled_by

admin_program_tab.details: Admin Dashboard shows 'Program' tab (not 'Check-in'), displays AdminScheduleView with all drivers

admin_analytics_no_revenue.details: Admin Analytics tab shows order charts without revenue/financial data

admin_orders_by_restaurant_chart.details: Admin Analytics shows 'Comenzi per Restaurant' horizontal bar chart

admin_cancelled_orders_section.details: Admin Analytics shows 'Comenzi Anulate' section with cancelled order count

driver_schedule_calendar.details: Driver app shows DriverSchedule component with weekly calendar when no active order

restaurant_cancel_dialog.details: Restaurant app has cancel button that opens dialog requiring reason input

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed seeds demo data - ran before testing

mocked_apis.hourly_stats: Simulated data using today's date as random seed - consistent per day
mocked_apis.driver_movement: Frontend-only simulation - positions change every 3s for active drivers

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 features fully implemented and tested. Backend uses modular routers (auth, orders, stats, schedules, drivers, restaurants, seed). Schedule system stores weekly slots with total_hours. Analytics endpoint requires admin role. Cancel order requires cancellation_reason. All UI components use Romanian language. Charts use recharts library.
